title: skills/docs: teach the one effective read of a `.custom` declared override (N-10's owed Skills-docs follow-up; the first slice of N-30)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BtyH9zgxKzYrJiH18J

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (the P3 row **N-30 skills and docs**, not cut yet) · filed by the lane seat because PR #28507 (N-10, #28409) declares `Metadata-protocol: semantic` and owes `Skills-docs: follow-up owed`; the review checklist has the seat file that card and rewrite the line to `#N` before ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (child N-30, first slice) · lane: the epic PM's skills/docs PR (`skills/**` is a governed surface, Tier H) · size: S.

**Business reason.** An author or an AI agent who customizes an installed package (HotCRM) learns from the skills and the docs where the change lives and what the platform serves. After #28507, the served document for a name X ships is X's `<X>.custom` item that declares `overrides.package = X`, on every read. That covers the read naming no package, `?package=X`, the layered read, the list scoped to X or not, and X's app. The export of `<X>.custom` carries the `overrides` block. A skill that still teaches the Setup overlay as the only customization path writes rows that the read treats as orphans, or as package-unbound rows awaiting N-16's migration. If nothing is done, agents keep writing the old shape.

**What to teach (from #28507, read at head `f62e0af4`).**
1. The `overrides: { package, basedOn }` declaration takes effect on the read only in X's pair. The pair is bound by the row's `package_id`, the type must be overridable, and `basedOn` is recorded and never judged. A declaration in any other package is ignored.
2. The env-wide list serves one item per name a single code package ships. A dependent package's same-named item stays under its own `?package=` address. A package-unbound row still wins until ADR-0146 D11 / N-16.
3. The layered read reports orphans (an undeclared pair row, or a row in a dependent package) in `overlay` with `effective` = X's code document.
4. Public forms: an override can narrow anonymous intake but never re-open a form any honoured body withdrew.
5. Export: `GET /packages/<X>.custom/export` carries the override with `overrides`. X's own export is unchanged.

**Readers who act.** The epic PM of #28236, folding this into N-30 when it cuts P3. Candidate surfaces, unmeasured: `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, `content/docs/references/system/metadata-persistence.mdx`, `content/docs/references/api/package-api.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`.

**Dedupe.** Searched issues: `"N-30"` (69 hits, none a card for it; #28236 lists it as plan of record), `overrides skills docs custom` (42 hits, none on teaching the read), `"effective read" override skills` (11 hits, none). No existing card covers it.

**Not here.** The write gate (N-09) and the flow override (N-11) owe their own teaching when they land. N-30 keeps the rest of the epic's skills and docs.
